## Ten seconds

No agent has played a human or a real CS2 match yet. The agents train on generated maps and meet Dust2 only as an exam, in 5v5 rounds on a 28×28 board.

Agents make first contact at a median of <N k="tempo.b28.contact.median" />, <Stamp measuredOn={on("tempo.b28.contact.median")} />; they also plant about twice as fast as the pros, at <N k="tempo.b28.plant.median" alt />.

The holder beats peeker in most duels, and the agents have not yet beaten pros. The 3v3 peak of <N k="elo.3v3.peak" /> sits on a different scale from the gain of <N k="elo.head.block2" ci /> at block 28.

Maps from the v2 generator ran on a friend's RTX 2080 Ti and a desktop GTX 1660 Ti, after about <N k="compute.cloud.usd" alt /> of cloud GPU. The readout of 4 November 2026 is dated 2026-11-04; see [the paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347) and Figure 1. Data: [`cs2-demos`](https://huggingface.co/datasets/cs2povarchive/cs2-demos) (`Apache-2.0`).

In one round, <EloSentenceBlock />.
